title: Friends - Seishun no Kagayaki (Japan, Disc 1): built-in instruction edits
summary: Apply both upstream instruction NOPs only to the game disc.
rationale: Both discs share product ID T-20109G. The callback writes both loaded addresses on Disc 2 even though its first-read file ends before them; this recipe applies only to the matching Disc 1 sectors.

writes.effect: NOP the Disc 1 ADV.BIN instruction loaded at 060428E8.
writes.reason: Preserve the upstream Friends game-disc edit on its matching source.
